fusions.name: Shed Spores
fusions.desc: Breathes out spores grown from your own body at the cost of 4% of your maximum health, dealing 7 damage to everything in a cone 4 tiles long with a 40% chance to leave each [Poisoned] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Overnight Fruiting
fusions.desc: Lobs a slow, swollen cap that bursts on the first enemy it meets, dealing 28 damage to it and 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, and leaving the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Mycelium Mat
fusions.desc: Spreads a mat of growth where you stand. For 12 seconds it restores 3 health a second to you and any ally inside it.

fusions.name: Larger Each Morning
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%. It also regenerates 0.5 health a second, permanently.
